_doc: The Phase 3 station frame: the midline skeleton every 2.5 m (author_expansion build_midline + gauss_smooth on the fresh OSM legs), y_3dep = 3DEP midline height - origin.elev_m, the curb offsets and median from this run's eye re-read (linear between readings). It is the frame aerial__paint_west.json is measured in. NOT Step 1's expansion.west.json: no pads, no stubs, no welds, no smoothing of the profile.

frame.what: data/centerline.local.json's local frame (x east, z north), tools/author_expansion.Frame

stations_frame: s = metres along the clockwise OSM leg from its start junction node; offsets + = left of the clockwise direction
